subject: Evaluation plan & MAP: observability retention + premium support bundle
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: cto@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 2 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring a short eval + MAP for observability & support

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profiles and token-cost visibility were the most convincing parts for our infra team. Nimbus is planning a six-week technical evaluation to validate cost/perf under our bursty workload. Before we lock dates, the execs want a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to the commercial close (commits, ramp schedule, and discounts).

High level asks from our side:
- 6-week PoC window, with a 30k token/day cap and an initial 2-week burn test at 50k/day.
- Extended observability: 90-day retention for per-route metrics (we currently have 30d).
- Premium support add-on during evaluation (SLAs + 4x support credits for on-call engineering time).
- Pricing guardrails that scale discount with commit tier (QPS/commit months).

Can your team draft a MAP that lists milestones, acceptance criteria, and what the associated commercial triggers would be? We want to align a commit by the end of the eval if performance is as shown.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call Fri if helpful.

—Aisha
Aisha Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Analytics
A: (650) 555-0132

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 2 Aug 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring a short eval + MAP for observability & support

Hi Aisha — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. I put together an initial MAP draft (attached) that ties the PoC milestones to commercial milestones and a proposed pricing snapshot.

Quick summary of our proposal:
- Evaluation window: 6 weeks total. Week 1–2: high-burn stress test (50k tokens/day), Weeks 3–6: production-ish traffic up to 30k/day.
- Acceptance criteria: latency median < 150ms  p95 < 350ms for inference; observability events show per-route breakdowns and KV-hit rates available in Console.
- Commercial triggers:
  * If acceptance criteria met by EOW Week 6 -> commit to a 12-month Reserved Capacity (tier A) with 20% volume discount (starts at month 1 of contract) + credit for 1 month of observability retention upgrade.
  * If performance met but adoption ramp is slower -> 9-month commit (tier B) with 12% discount + 2 months retention credit.
- Premium support add-on: included as a time-limited promotion during the eval (4 on-call credits). Long-term support package must be purchased as an add-on; we proposed priced credits in the snapshot.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, redwood_pricing_snapshot.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf (SOC2 summary for your security team).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the MAP draft and pricing snapshot — confirm any tweaks to retention length or discount thresholds.
2) We can schedule a MAP kick-off Monday to finalize milestones and assign owners.
3) Jordan will help with discount approvals and legal will prepare a draft term sheet if we align on the MAP.

If that sounds good I can loop in our finance & legal today.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
M: (415) 555-0199

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@nimbusanalytics.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP: observability retention + premium support bundle

Aisha / Neha — looping in on discounts/credits. A few internal notes so we’re transparent:
- The 20% discount for a 12-month reserved capacity is approvable but tied to a committed baseline (we suggested a minimum steady-state qps equivalent to 250M tokens/month).
- For shorter commits (9 months) we can do 12% but would require a modest ramp commitment schedule (month-by-month minimums).
- Observability retention extension (90d) can be included as a one-time migration credit (we’ll cover storage cost for first 2 months). Long term retention pricing is line-itemed in the snapshot.
- Premium support: we can include the 4 on-call credits during the evaluation at no charge. Ongoing premium support remains an add-on and we’re open to structuring pre-paid credits as part of the bundle.

Action items for Nimbus: please confirm the target steady-state tokens/month you expect after month 3 so we can map to tier thresholds.

Linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890 — Aisha, if you add estimated ARR and expected close date there it helps accelerate approvals.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Patel <aisha@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2025 10:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP: observability retention + premium support bundle

Thanks Jordan and Neha — this looks very close. A couple of clarifications from our side after an internal sync:
- Steady-state expectation: ~220M tokens/month by month 4 (after pilot converts). Initial ramp slower — week 3 should average 40k/day, week 6 target 120k/day.
- Observability retention: we need 90d retention for per-route metrics for compliance reasons for at least the first 6 months post-contract. Would prefer a 6-month retention credit rather than 2 months if possible.
- Premium support credits: we appreciate the eval credits; can the ongoing support credits be offered as a small pre-paid block (e.g., 12 credits) bundled into the first quarter at a discounted rate?

We’re ready to move fast once we have the MAP updated to reflect a 6-month retention credit and a table that maps committed monthly tokens to discount tiers. Also need a clear DocuSign-ready term sheet we can show procurement.

Happy to jump on the MAP kick-off Monday; can you send a calendar invite?

Best,
Aisha

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan & MAP: observability retention + premium support bundle

Aisha — thanks for the clarifications. I updated the MAP and commercial snapshot to reflect your requests. Summary of changes: 
- Retention credit increased to 6 months for per-route observability metrics (as a one-time credit applied to first invoice).
- Discount tiers (summary):
  * Tier A (>=220M tokens/month steady-state): 20% volume discount + 6-month retention credit + 12 pre-paid support credits at 10% off list.
  * Tier B (>=140M tokens/month): 12% discount + 3-month retention credit + 6 pre-paid credits at 5% off.
  * No-commit / eval rollover: standard usage rates; eval credits apply but no volume discount.
- Evaluation: 6-week window as before. We’ll provision the premium support credits for the eval.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_snapshot.xlsx (updated), mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (v1.1 - MAP with milestones and owner matrix). I also added a DocuSign term sheet link for procurement review: https://www.docusign.com/RAFT/ABC-123-nimbus-term.

Next steps:
1) I’ll send a calendar invite for the MAP kick-off Monday 9am PT.
2) Jordan will prep the term sheet and route for approvals.
3) If procurement has a preferred PO/contract template, please share prior to the call.

Quote from MAP (milestone / commercial trigger):
"Week 6 acceptance -> Contract signature within 10 business days -> Reserved capacity starts within first billing cycle."

If that reads OK I’ll get legal to prepare the DocuSign and finance to prepare the initial invoice offsetting the retention credit.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
